user_reviews.Name: Bazour Esrifarni (Baz)
user_reviews.Description:
I am no stranger to writing reviews, and I usually try to be fair and balanced, but my recent experience at Costa Coffee deserves to be called out for what it was: overpriced, poor quality, and deeply disappointing.

I went in with two children, expecting a simple breakfast, nothing fancy, just enough to keep everyone fed and happy while out. Between us, we ordered two toasties, a croissant, two bottled drinks for the kids, and one hot chocolate. That was it. When the bill came, I was absolutely shocked to see the total: £22. For what was essentially a tray of snacks, this price is completely unjustifiable.

If the quality matched the cost, I might have let it go, but unfortunately, it was the opposite. The toasties were the biggest letdown. Both were undercooked, soggy, and barely warm in places. Instead of being crisp and golden with a gooey filling, they were limp and unpleasant to eat. For something so basic, it was inexcusable.

The croissant was no better, dry, stale, and heavy. Croissants should be light, flaky, and buttery. This one tasted like it had been sitting around all week, maybe longer. Honestly, I would have been disappointed with it even if I’d paid half the price.

The drinks weren’t much to write home about either. The kids had small bottled juices, which added disproportionately to the bill considering you can buy the same bottles in a supermarket for a fraction of the price. My hot chocolate was the only halfway decent item, but even then, it was more watery than rich, topped with a thin layer of cocoa powder. It was drinkable, yes, but certainly nothing special, especially when it makes up part of a £22 total.

What makes me most frustrated is that this is Costa, a brand that presents itself as a trusted high-street coffee shop where families can pop in for a reliable treat. But reliability means consistency, quality, and fair value. On this occasion, I got none of those. Instead, I left feeling ripped off, annoyed, and honestly a bit embarrassed that I’d just spent that amount of money for such a poor experience while trying to treat my children.

At £22, I could have taken the kids to a local independent café and had freshly prepared food, bigger portions, and change left over. In fact, for not much more I could have taken them to a sit-down family restaurant. Instead, I handed over a significant sum of money for food that felt rushed, carelessly made, and simply not worth it.

I don’t expect luxury from Costa, but I do expect value and decent preparation. Toasties should be hot, crisp, and cooked properly every time. Croissants should taste fresh. Drinks should feel like they’re worth what you’re paying. None of this happened, and the price tag only added insult to injury.

To be clear, I am not someone who complains for the sake of it, I write reviews regularly and I am fair when credit is due. But this was an experience where Costa badly failed, both in quality and in fairness. £22 for undercooked toasties, a stale croissant, two tiny juices, and a watery hot chocolate is nothing short of a rip-off.

I’ll be thinking twice before taking my children to Costa again. Families deserve better than this.

user_reviews.Name: Lunar Orbit
user_reviews.Description:
The food is mediocre, as you would expect, but it's the service that really sucks.

Three people behind the counter working, a couple others seem to come and go, three customers in the place, but none of the employees can be bothered to take a coffee order without grumbling.  Mostly they like to look at their phones.  Asking for the cinnamon roll to be warmed is the ultimate insult, more grumbling. Ask a question or want oat milk in your latte? more grumbling.  Craig in particular likes to grumble.

And this complaint is for people in the corporate offices:  What's the point in having high-tech menu screens when they keep flipping to other images of strawberries and green special drinks so that you can't see the menu options.

Seems like one person with a good attitude could replace all of them.
My advice:  Go elsewhere.

user_reviews.Name: Ace
user_reviews.Description:
I had such a great experience at Costa Coffee recently and felt it deserved a proper review. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was warm, relaxed, and welcoming. The staff were genuinely friendly and made the whole visit feel easy and enjoyable. It’s always nice when a place feels like they actually care about their customers, and that was definitely the case here.

The coffee itself was excellent. Perfectly made, rich in flavour, and served at just the right temperature. You can really tell they take pride in what they do. I also grabbed a snack to go with it, and it was fresh, tasty, and a great match with the drink.

What stood out the most was how clean and comfortable the café was. It’s the kind of place where you can sit down, relax for a bit, catch up with someone, or even get some work done without feeling rushed.

Overall, it was a fantastic experience. Great coffee, lovely staff, and a really nice atmosphere. I’ll definitely be coming back again and would happily recommend this Costa to anyone looking for a good coffee and a welcoming place to sit and unwind.

user_reviews.Name: Klaas Klaas
user_reviews.Description:
My review from few months ago :
"Can you please train your staff, new guy make me a latte not really hot, I asked him to do it a second time and it was almost the same, he wasn't able to use his machine correctly, also I had black dots in the latte. Frustrating. That happens to me again, I will avoid new staff now."

Nothing change, always the same guy, not trained. It becomes very frustrating. The milk must to be steamed not just making hot. And latte should have a bit foam on top

Information can help:
"Making hot milk just means heating it (like in a microwave or pan), while steaming milk uses pressurized steam to heat and aerate it, creating a silky, sweet, microfoam texture with tiny, integrated bubbles, perfect for lattes, whereas regular hot milk is simpler, and "frothed" milk (often confused with steamed) is fluffier with bigger, separate bubbles. Steaming transforms milk's proteins and fats, breaking them down for a smoother, sweeter, more stable liquid that blends beautifully with espresso, unlike just heating it which can scald the milk"

I spoke with the manager and another member of the staff remake my drink. Good customer service. All nice staff, just some need more training. Thanks again for the manager

user_reviews.Description:
Very disappointing experience at this Costa.

On 05 June 2026 at approximately 17:45 I visited this store to redeem a free drink reward from my Costa app. After scanning the reward, nothing happened and I simply asked for help.

Instead of assisting me, a staff member who identified herself as Julia became dismissive, refused to explain what was happening, refused to serve me, and refused to provide manager contact details when I requested them.

I am currently pregnant ( 20 week +) and left the store extremely upset and in tears. I have never experienced customer service like this in any Costa before.

A formal complaint has been submitted to Costa Head Office and I hope the matter is properly investigated.

user_reviews.Name: Pete
user_reviews.Description: Costa coffee. Costa lot! (Costs a lot) but needs must at this hour. Small cappuccino for me, browsed the butties but nothing appealed, a recent banana still satiated me. The service was swift and the staff friendly. The cappuccino had a pleasant ‘jiggle’ and was a worthy companion to a chapter of P.D James’ ‘The Children of Men.’ Preferable to a Starbucks if you ask me. Starbucks? What am I, some sort of commuting astronaut sucking down my space coffee? No I’m not. Daft name. Forgive my aside, this Costa was alright.

user_reviews.Description:
As a regular customer of Costa coffee I was very impressed with the service. First time I’ve been to the terminal 3 branch.

Drinks were spot on including my flat white and service was 10/10. Food was done same time as my drinks even though they were really busy. Sometimes I noticed in other branches that they don’t take care to cover the cakes on the stand, which makes them very dry and a waste of money, but that was not the case here. Lemon cake was nice and moist 👍🏻👍🏻 Shoutout to David for his customer service that made the real difference.

user_reviews.Name: S4rgentDash
user_reviews.Description:
We stopped at Costa for a little bite to eat before dinner, and (as usual) it was amazing. I got their December-exlusive Gingerbread Latte, along with a blueberry muffin; both these were fantastic! The Latte was really nice, I highly recommend getting it before it's gone until next year. It wasn't too loud for being open in a busy shopping centre, it was easy to hear everyone talk. Only issue is that there wasn't much table space, as we had to fit 6 of us around a small table, but that was only because it was quite full in there (just further shows that it's great food :D).
Anyways, great experience, great food, great service. Great!
